evidence_checked: overlay EO_11726 EVIDENCE.json and DOSSIER.json (OFR notes: superseded to extent inconsistent by EO 11748; superseded by EO 11775)
reasons: Hashes and spans match; identity confirmed (EO 11726, June 29, 1973, 38 FR 17711). The end of the 17 continuing clauses on March 26, 1974 by EO 11775 Sec. 1 is supported. EO 11775 recites that the Office continued on an interim basis after EO 11748, so treating the EO 11748 partial supersession as a later event is defensible under the evidence-decides ruling, and Sec. 5 ends on signing. Both OFR notes are addressed. Rejected for the 19-versus-18 count in the rationale, and for omitting the 1973 statutory change to the Director's appointment, shown in a held source the claim's own search found. Also: EO 11743 (October 23, 1973) made the Director chairman of the Oil Policy Committee, which bears on Sec. 2(b)(7).

evidence_checked: overlay EO_11957 EVIDENCE.json and DOSSIER.json (OFR notes on EO 13241 and EO 13240; 1989 codification in force)
reasons: Hashes and spans match; identity confirmed (EO 11957, January 13, 1977, 42 FR 3295, officers to act as Secretary of Agriculture). The two-clause inventory is complete. Sec. 2 (revocation of EO 11793) is exhausted on signing. Sec. 1 ends on December 18, 2001 by EO 13241 Sec. 4, an express, unqualified revocation with no delayed effective date and no savings. The conflicting OFR note crediting EO 13240 is correctly rejected: the held EO 13240 concerns GRECO immunities. The 1989 codification lists the order in force. Reviewer note: the 1998 replacement of the cited authority (5 U.S.C. 3347) is not discussed, but EO 13241 acts under the successor subchapter and no held source shows an earlier extinction, so under the evidence-decides ruling it is not an end. The whole-order end equals the latest clause end.

evidence_checked: overlay EO_9674 EVIDENCE.json and DOSSIER.json (OFR note "Revoked by: EO 9744, June 27, 1946"; 1989 codification ended)
reasons: Hashes and spans match; identity confirmed (EO 9674, January 4, 1946, 11 FR 333, Liquidation of War Agencies). The 10-clause inventory (paragraph 1, the paragraph 2 lead and (a) to (f), paragraphs 3 and 4) is complete. EO 9744 (signed June 27, 1946, 11 FR 7255) terminates the Director's office and the Committee "together with the functions" and states "This order shall become effective on June 30, 1946", so every clause ends June 30, 1946, and body_abolished fits. There is no own-terms end, and no held instrument acts on the order earlier. The records-disposition duty is a new command of EO 9744. The whole-order end equals the latest clause end.

evidence_checked: overlay EO_12348 EVIDENCE.json and DOSSIER.json (OFR notes revoked by / revokes EO 12512; 1989 codification revoked)
reasons: Hashes and spans match; identity confirmed (EO 12348, February 25, 1982, 47 FR 8547, Federal Real Property). The 19-clause inventory is complete. EO 12512 Sec. 4 (April 29, 1985, 50 FR 18453) revokes the order expressly and wholly, with no delayed effective date and no savings, and the OFR notes agree. Sec. 8 (revocation of EO 11954) is exhausted on signing. Carrying the 60-day report in Sec. 3(b) as a deadline until the revocation is consistent with the evidence-decides ruling. L. 97-276 sec. 111 (1982), a funding condition that presupposes the Board and does not amend or end the order, and a 1998 GSA notice that mentions the revoked order without reviving it. The whole-order end equals the latest clause end.
